# Outlaw Trading Cards

> Outlaw Trading Cards is an online trading-card shop and live-break marketplace. It sells authenticated graded slabs, sealed wax, autos and singles direct, runs live auctions with real reserves, and streams live group breaks (pack rips) with in-site chat and instant spot claiming. Categories span Pokémon, sports (basketball, football, baseball) and TCG. Brand voice: outlaw, no-gatekeepers, "collect without permission."

## Pages
- [Home](https://outlawtradingcards.com/): Overview — buy direct, bid at auction, or watch/join live breaks.
- [Shop](https://outlawtradingcards.com/shop/): Buy graded slabs, sealed wax, autos and singles direct. Filter by Pokémon, basketball, football, baseball, TCG.
- [Auctions](https://outlawtradingcards.com/auctions/): Live timed auctions on grails, 1-of-1 hits and sealed wax with real reserves and live countdowns.
- [Live](https://outlawtradingcards.com/live/): Live-streamed group breaks and pack rips with live chat and buy-in break spots, streamed on-site.
- [Our Story](https://outlawtradingcards.com/about/): Why the brand exists — authenticity-first, fair pricing, community-driven; consignment and contact.

## About
Outlaw Trading Cards is part of the Outlaw family of brands. Contact: hello@outlawtradingcards.com.
